label: Formulated decision-theoretic wager on divine existence in Pensées
description: Blaise Pascal formulated and introduced the concept of "Pascal's Wager", which became a seminal contribution in epistemology philosophy.
dialecticalTension: Formulating an epistemic apparatus to resolve central problems in epistemology.
historicalContext: Introduced during the Early Modern & Scientific as part of Blaise Pascal's canonical writings.

label: Precursor to existential dread, leap of faith, and paradoxical Christianity
description: Søren Kierkegaard was fundamentally influenced by Blaise Pascal's central inquiries, which shaped the evolution of their philosophical worldview.
dialecticalTension: Negotiating the intellectual shift from Blaise Pascal's perspective to Søren Kierkegaard's reconstructed system.
historicalContext: Inter-epochal reception: transmitting insights from the Early Modern & Scientific across history into the 19th Century Divergences.
